rules-payment.title: Payment and privacy

cases.situation: Accepting a donated antenna for passing a family's messages.
cases.why: No payment of any kind, including equipment.

cases.situation: Telling a reporter what you heard on a police channel.
cases.why: Divulging non-amateur radiocommunications to the media is an offence.

cases.situation: Quoting another amateur's transmission in your club newsletter.

rules-payment.success: Never for payment, and keep other services' traffic private.
